observations: The current standard PMTiles crossing aligns with the authored model and separate approach viaducts.
Main suspension/anchorage asset leaves native M48 viaducts and shore roads independent.
Native connection samples must follow the two mapped carriageway centers, not the unpaved center reservation.
preserved: Independent buildings, roads and approach bridges
limitations: Current tide, sea-plane conversion and approach grades are approximate.
Current native views and exact model/fixture pins are reviewed separately in qa.json.
